source:
grammar AsciiChemCore version "0.4.0" {
  ## The AsciiChem syntax — full grammar, DSL-shaped captures
  ## (P1b, asciichem-ruby#96). Capture names and nesting mirror
  ## GrammarRules exactly so the PARG tree adapts to the same shape
  ## TransformRules consumes: sequence captures merge into one hash
  ## (parens to attach `as`), repetitions stay arrays, unwrapped
  ## rules let their captures ride into the parent context. Absent
  ## optionals omit their key (the tree adapter reinstates the ones
  ## transform patterns require, e.g. group multiplicity). Structural
  ## rules (molecule/reaction/group/annotated_molecule) are captured
  ## and the adapter unwraps them: PARG merge semantics for captured
  ## sequences with embedded repetitions yield arrays, and uncaptured
  ## sequence rules drop captures non-deterministically in reps
  ## (parsanol findings).
  ##
  ## Language notes (P0 findings): entries reference rules; sequences
  ## take no trailing capture (wrap in parens); [ ] is the option
  ## syntax so literal brackets are strings; until is exclusive
  ## (restate the closer); strict PEG — no repetition backtracking.

  entry formula: formula

  ## spaces? >> nodes.as(:formula) >> spaces?
  formula = [ 1*( ws ) ] ( formula_node 0*( [ 1*( ws ) ] formula_node ) ) as formula [ 1*( ws ) ]

  ws = ( " " / %x09 / %x0A / %x0D )

  ## Top-level nodes, DSL ordered-choice order (cascade before plain
  ## reaction, annotations before bare molecule).
  formula_node = cascade / reaction / electron_config / crystal / spectrum / calculation / zmatrix / mechanism / annotated_molecule / molecule / embedded_math / ( "\"" until "\"" "\"" ) as text_run

  # -- reactions ---------------------------------------------------------

  ## Two or more chained reactions: the transform promotes the chain
  ## to a ReactionCascade (first leg + arrow/products segments).
  cascade = ( ( reaction ) as first ( 1*( cascade_segment ) ) as segments ) as cascade

  cascade_segment = ( arrow [ 1*( ws ) ] ( terms as products ) ) as segment

  ## Reactants, arrow (with optional above/below conditions), products.
  reaction = ( ( terms as reactants ) arrow [ 1*( ws ) ] ( terms as products ) ) as reaction

  terms = molecule 0*( plus_term )

  plus_term = ( [ 1*( ws ) ] "+" [ 1*( ws ) ] molecule ) as plus_term

  ## arrow.as(:arrow) {kind, above?, below?} — leading spaces ride the
  ## arrow, conditions attach with no gap.
  arrow = ( [ 1*( ws ) ] ( arrow_kind ) as kind [ condition as above ] [ condition as below ] ) as arrow

  arrow_kind = ( "<=>" / "<->" / "->" / "<-" )

  condition = ( "[" ( until "]" ) as text ( "]" ) as condition_close ) as condition

  ## A molecule: stereochemistry prefix, optional coefficient, units.
  molecule = ( [ stereo_prefix ] [ coefficient ] ( 1*( unit / bond ) ) as units ) as molecule

  ## `(R)-` style prefixes; a/b are the alpha/beta shorthand.
  stereo_prefix = "(" ( stereo_letter ) as stereo ")" "-"

  stereo_letter = ( "alpha" / "beta" / "R" / "S" / "E" / "Z" / "α" / "β" / "a" / "b" )

  ## Coefficient: digits only when an element or bracket follows (else
  ## the digits are subscripts/rings). Captured as {value}.
  coefficient = ( ( 1*(%x30-39) &( "(" / "[" / "{" / %x41-5A ) ) as value ) as coefficient

  ## Units: prefixed (isotope) atoms, bracket groups, hydrogen
  ## (bare-digit subscripts allowed), plain atoms.
  unit = prefixed_atom / group / hydrogen_atom / plain_atom

  ## Prefix isotope: ^14C or _14C — the marker binds to the atom, the
  ## core semantic fix over AsciiMath. Captured with the marker.
  prefixed_atom = ( [ lewis_prefix ] ( ( "^" / "_" ) 1*(%x30-39) ) as isotope ( %x41-5A [ %x61-7A ] ) as element atom_suffix [ lewis_radicals ] [ ( 1*(%x30-39) ) as ring_closures ] atom_annotation ) as atom

  ## Bracket group: ( ... ) [ ... ] { ... } with optional multiplicity.
  group = ( group_open ( 1*( group_unit ) ) as group_nodes group_close [ ( "_" 1*(%x30-39) ) as multiplicity ] ) as group

  group_open = ( "(" / "[" / "{" ) as open_bracket

  group_close = ( ")" / "]" / "}" ) as close_bracket

  ## Inside a group: reactions, molecules, electron configs, embedded
  ## math and quoted text recurse (DSL group_node set).
  group_unit = reaction / electron_config / molecule / group / embedded_math / ( "\"" until "\"" "\"" ) as group_text_run

  ## Hydrogen: bare digits after H are subscripts (H cannot ring-
  ## close), but H must not steal the H of He, Hf...
  hydrogen_atom = ( [ lewis_prefix ] ( "H" ) as element !( %x61-7A ) [ ( "_" subscript_value / 1*(%x30-39) ) as subscript ] [ ( "^" superscript_value ) as superscript ] [ lewis_radicals ] atom_annotation ) as atom

  plain_atom = ( [ lewis_prefix ] ( %x41-5A [ %x61-7A ] ) as element atom_suffix [ lewis_radicals ] [ ( 1*(%x30-39) ) as ring_closures ] atom_annotation ) as atom

  ## Suffix markers consume `_` / `^` but capture marker + value
  ## (AtomBuilder strips the marker).
  atom_suffix = [ ( "_" subscript_value ) as subscript ] [ ( "^" superscript_value ) as superscript ]

  subscript_value = ( "{" until "}" "}" ) / 1*(%x30-39)

  superscript_value = ( "{" until "}" "}" ) / ( oxidation_state / charge )

  ## Charges: 2+, +2, 2 (bare digits fall through to the same capture).
  charge = ( 1*(%x30-39) [ "+" / "-" ] ) / ( ( "+" / "-" ) [ 1*(%x30-39) ] )

  ## Oxidation state: (IV), (II)...
  oxidation_state = "(" 1*( %x49 / %x56 / %x58 / %x4C / %x43 / %x44 ) ")"

  ## Lewis markers: leading colons = lone pairs; trailing dots =
  ## radical electrons.
  lewis_prefix = 1*( ":" ) as lone_pairs

  lewis_radicals = 1*( "." ) as radical_electrons

  ## Atom annotations, DSL order: coordinates, parity, multiplicity,
  ## title, fractional coordinates.
  atom_annotation = [ coordinate_annotation ] [ parity_annotation ] [ chirality_annotation ] [ multiplicity_annotation ] [ title_annotation ] [ fractional_annotation ]

  coordinate_annotation = "@(" ( float_number ) as x2 "," ( float_number ) as y2 [ "," ( float_number ) as z2 ] ( ")" ) as coord_close

  parity_annotation = "@" ( "R" / "S" ) as atom_parity

  ## Tetrahedral parity classes (SMILES @/@@ semantics, spelled
  ## explicitly beside the CIP @R/@S label).
  chirality_annotation = "@" ( "TH1" / "TH2" ) as chirality

  multiplicity_annotation = "@m(" ( 1*(%x30-39) ) as spin_multiplicity ( ")" ) as spin_close

  title_annotation = "@t(" "\"" ( until "\"" ) as atom_title ( "\"" ) as title_quote ( ")" ) as title_close

  fractional_annotation = "@f(" ( float_number ) as x_fract "," ( float_number ) as y_fract "," ( float_number ) as z_fract ( ")" ) as fract_close

  float_number = [ "-" ] 1*(%x30-39) [ "." 0*(%x30-39) ]

  # -- bonds ---------------------------------------------------------------

  ## Bonds capture under their kind name (transform contract), longest
  ## first so `##` beats `#`; `->` is reserved for reactions.
  bond = ( "/" as direction_up ) / ( "\\" as direction_down ) / ( "##" as quadruple ) / ( ">-" as wedge ) / ( "-<" as hash ) / ( "~>" as dative ) / ( "~~" as wavy ) / ( "#" as triple ) / ( "=" as double ) / ( "-" as single )

  # -- beyond-formulas constructs -----------------------------------------

  ## crystal[Name](a=X,b=Y,sg=SG){atoms with @f(x,y,z)}
  crystal = ( "crystal" [ ( "[" ( until "]" ) as crystal_name ( "]" ) as crystal_name_close ) ] [ ( "(" ( until ")" ) as crystal_params ( ")" ) as crystal_params_close ) ] [ ( "{" ( until "}" ) as crystal_body ( "}" ) as crystal_body_close ) ] ) as crystal_node

  ## spectrum[type](params){peak data}
  spectrum = ( "spectrum" [ ( "[" ( until "]" ) as spectrum_type ( "]" ) as spectrum_type_close ) ] [ ( "(" ( until ")" ) as spectrum_params ( ")" ) as spectrum_params_close ) ] [ ( "{" ( until "}" ) as spectrum_body ( "}" ) as spectrum_body_close ) ] ) as spectrum_node

  ## calc(method/basis){key: value units}
  calculation = ( "calc" [ ( "(" ( until ")" ) as calc_params ( ")" ) as calc_params_close ) ] [ ( "{" ( until "}" ) as calc_body ( "}" ) as calc_body_close ) ] ) as calc_node

  ## zmatrix{lines}
  zmatrix = ( "zmatrix" [ ( "{" ( until "}" ) as zmatrix_body ( "}" ) as zmatrix_body_close ) ] ) as zmatrix_node

  ## mechanism{steps}
  mechanism = ( "mechanism" [ ( "{" ( until "}" ) as mechanism_body ( "}" ) as mechanism_body_close ) ] ) as mechanism_node

  # -- electron configuration ----------------------------------------------

  ## `1s2 2s2 2p6` — at least two orbital terms (DSL repeat(2)).
  electron_config = 2*( orbital "^" ( 1*(%x30-39) ) as occupancy [ 1*( ws ) ] ) as electron_config

  orbital = ( 1*(%x30-39) ( "s" / "p" / "d" / "f" / "g" / "h" ) ) as orbital

  # -- embedded math and text ------------------------------------------------

  ## Backtick-delimited Plurimath/AsciiMath source (delimiters stripped
  ## by the transform).
  embedded_math = ( "`" ( until "`" ) as math_source ( "`" ) as math_close ) as embedded_math

  ## Free-form text uses "..." delimiters, matching AsciiMath; the
  ## capture includes the quotes (TextNormaliser strips them).

  # -- molecule annotations ---------------------------------------------------

  ## @name("aspirin") @cas("50-78-2") @meta("k","v") — the annotation
  ## vocabulary rides the molecule.
  annotated_molecule = ( ( molecule ) as mol ( 1*( annotation_item ) ) as annotations ) as annotated_molecule

  annotation_item = ( [ 1*( ws ) ] ( metadata_annotation / simple_annotation ) ) as annotation_item

  ## Two quoted args, comma-separated; keys distinguish metadata from
  ## regular annotations.
  metadata_annotation = "@meta(" "\"" ( until "\"" ) as meta_key "\"" "," "\"" ( until "\"" ) as meta_value ( "\"" ) as meta_value_close ( ")" ) as meta_close

  ## Known types (name, inchi, ...) handled specially by the transform;
  ## any other lowercase word becomes a property.
  simple_annotation = "@" ( ( known_annotation_type / property_name ) as ann_type "(" "\"" ( until "\"" ) as ann_value ( "\"" ) as ann_value_close ( ")" ) as ann_close )

  known_annotation_type = ( "name" / "title" / "formula" / "label" / "inchi" / "smiles" / "cas" / "iupac" / "cid" / "chebi" )

  property_name = 1*( %x61-7A )

  test formula {
    accept "H_2O"
    accept "H2O"
    accept "Ca^2+"
    accept "SO_4^2-"
    accept "C1-C-C-C-C-C1"
    accept "C12-C-C1-C2"
    accept "CH_3-CH_2-OH"
    accept "2H_2 + O_2 -> 2H_2O"
    accept "N_2 + 3H_2 <=>[Fe][400C] 2NH_3"
    accept "A ->[heat] B ->[cool] C"
    accept "A -> B -> C -> D"
    accept "Ca(OH)_2"
    accept "Fe(IV)"
    accept "_14C"
    accept "^14C"
    accept "CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O"
    accept "Ca^2+ + CO_3^2- -> CaCO_3"
    accept "(R)-CH_3CH(OH)COOH"
    accept ":O"
    accept "1s^2 2s^2 2p^6"
    accept "`x^2`"
    accept "\"nitrogen gas\""
    accept "crystal[NaCl](a=5.64,sg=Fm-3m){Na@f(0,0,0)}"
    accept "spectrum[nmr](type=1H){1.2: 3H s \"CH3\"}"
    accept "calc(b3lyp){energy: -234.5}"
    accept "zmatrix{ C1 H2 C1 1.09 }"
    accept "mechanism{ step1: A -> B }"
    accept "H_2O @name(\"water\") @cas(\"7732-18-5\")"
    accept "H_2O @meta(\"source\",\"handbook\")"
    accept "  H_2O  "
    accept "C@(10,20)@R@m(2)@t(\"C1\")"
    reject ""
    reject "???"
    reject "H_"
    reject "C(=O"
    reject "+ H_2O"
    reject "crystal[NaCl"
    reject "zmatrix{ C1 "
    reject "@name(\"x\") H_2O"
  }
}
